heard: You do not need 25,000 miles per hour to escape Earth. That massive speed is only required if you use a single unpowered launch boost. If you fire a projectile and let gravity do all the work, you genuinely need 11.2 kilometers per second. But modern rockets are not unpowered cannonballs designed for a single blast. By keeping their engines burning, they can climb at a leisurely walking pace and still slip away completely. Escape velocity is simply the total energy cost needed to leave Earth for good. Thanks to continuous thrust, you do not have to pay that steep gravity bill all at once. This is why you do not need 25,000 miles per hour to escape Earth.
